chunks: And Hishām ibn al-Ḥakam narrated from him that he said:
"Dates in the fiṭrah are better than other than them, because they are quicker in benefit; that is because when they fall into the hand of their owner, he eats from them."
He said: "And zakat was sent down while the people had no wealth, and there was only fiṭrah."

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: better or more excellent in preference
key_terms.التَّمْرُ: dates, the preferred item mentioned for zakat al-fiṭrah
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةِ: zakat al-fiṭrah, the alms due at the end of fasting
key_terms.مَنْفَعَةً: benefit, referring to quick usefulness for the recipient

ai.seo_question: Why are dates considered the best item to give for zakat al-fiṭrah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that dates are preferable for zakat al-fiṭrah because they provide immediate benefit to the recipient as food. It also indicates an early context in which people had little wealth, so fiṭrah functioned as the practical form of zakat available to them.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2075 - It is narrated from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), who said:
"Dates are preferred for Zakat al-Fitr over other items because they are of quicker benefit. When they reach the hands of the recipient, they can immediately eat from them."
Imam (as) added: "Zakat was revealed at a time when people did not have much wealth; thus, Zakat al-Fitr was established."
